name: Signal Indigo
territory: Proprietary digital signal color — an ownable, highly saturated indigo-violet as the single brand hue, paired with a warm coral counter-accent so the system never reads as generic all-blue AI tech.
dominanceRatio: 72% neutrals (background/surface/text/border) · 18% primary indigo (CTAs, active nav, links, selected states, key brand touchpoints) · 10% coral accent + semantic (used only for highlight badges, celebratory moments, and status)
primaryAppearsWhere: Primary CTA buttons, active/selected nav and tab states, focus rings, links, progress/loading indicators, the logo tile background, key brand touchpoints (top bar mark, empty-state illustration accents).
primaryMustNotAppearWhere: Body/result text color, large full-bleed backgrounds, generated Visual Studio imagery frames/borders (would compete with user content), disabled states, error/destructive actions (error has its own token).
logoUsage: Context-dependent: black on white/light neutral surfaces, white on dark or primary-indigo surfaces. The logo itself is never recolored into the primary indigo — it stays strictly monochrome (true black or true white) per the locked master; indigo appears in the surrounding UI chrome, not the mark.
